look: Vault Devourer, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Hoard Mimics family: whole vault door mimic on stubby legs, its door a giant fanged mouth. Family anatomy: mimics disguised as crates, chests and vault doors with toothy lids and sticky tongues. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are gold-flecked citrine crystal. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Neutral: weathered brown, iron grey and brass accents, vivid sweeping dust motes and glinting coins
